exposure: Non-fixation in laparoscopic transabdominal preperitoneal (TAPP) inguinal hernioplasty
Mesh fixation in laparoscopic transabdominal preperitoneal (TAPP) inguinal hernioplasty
finding: There was no significant difference between mesh fixation and non-fixation in terms of operative time, intraoperative injury, hospital stay, mesh migration, nerve entrapment, and postoperative analgesia.
